name: Kathy Hochul
title: Governor of New York
bio: Kathy Hochul became New York's 57th Governor in August 2021 following Andrew Cuomo's resignation, and won a full term in November 2022. A Buffalo native, she previously served as Lieutenant Governor, U.S. Representative for NY-26, and Erie County Clerk.

name: Antonio Delgado
title: Lieutenant Governor of New York
bio: Antonio Delgado was appointed Lieutenant Governor in 2022 following Brian Benjamin's resignation. A former Hudson Valley congressman, musician, and Harvard Law graduate, he is focused on economic development and community revitalization.

name: Letitia James
title: Attorney General of New York
bio: Letitia James has served as New York Attorney General since 2019, becoming the first Black woman elected to statewide office in New York. She has pursued major cases against the NRA, opioid manufacturers, and the Trump Organization.

name: Thomas DiNapoli
title: New York State Comptroller
bio: Thomas DiNapoli has served as New York State Comptroller since 2007, overseeing the state pension fund, auditing state agencies, and approving state contracts. A former Long Island assemblyman, he has been a national leader in fossil fuel divestment from the pension fund.

name: Chuck Schumer
title: U.S. Senator (Minority Leader)
bio: Chuck Schumer has represented New York in the U.S. Senate since 1999 and serves as Senate Minority Leader. A Brooklyn native, he is known for tenacious constituent services and was the lead Senate champion of the CHIPS Act and Inflation Reduction Act.

name: Kirsten Gillibrand
title: U.S. Senator
bio: Kirsten Gillibrand has represented New York in the U.S. Senate since 2009, appointed to fill Hillary Clinton's seat. She has been a leading voice on military sexual assault reform and chairs the Armed Services personnel subcommittee.

name: Nick LaLota
title: U.S. Representative – NY-01
bio: Nick LaLota represents New York's 1st Congressional District on eastern Long Island. A Navy veteran and former chief of staff to the Suffolk County Legislature, he was first elected in 2022.

name: Tom Suozzi
title: U.S. Representative – NY-03
bio: Tom Suozzi represents New York's 3rd Congressional District, won in a February 2024 special election. A former Nassau County Executive and moderate Democrat, he campaigned heavily on immigration reform.

name: Laura Gillen
title: U.S. Representative – NY-04
bio: Laura Gillen represents New York's 4th Congressional District in southwestern Nassau County. A former town supervisor of Hempstead, she flipped this suburban seat from Republicans in 2024.

name: Gregory Meeks
title: U.S. Representative – NY-05
bio: Gregory Meeks has represented New York's 5th Congressional District since 1998. He is the ranking member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee and a prominent member of the Congressional Black Caucus.

name: Grace Meng
title: U.S. Representative – NY-06
bio: Grace Meng has represented New York's 6th Congressional District since 2013. She is the first Asian American elected to Congress from New York, representing diverse communities in central Queens.

name: Nydia Velázquez
title: U.S. Representative – NY-07
bio: Nydia Velázquez has represented New York's 7th Congressional District since 1993. She was the first Puerto Rican woman elected to Congress and is the ranking member of the House Small Business Committee.

name: Hakeem Jeffries
title: U.S. Representative – NY-08 (House Minority Leader)
bio: Hakeem Jeffries has represented New York's 8th Congressional District since 2013 and is the House Minority Leader, the first Black American to lead a party in Congress. A Brooklyn native, he previously served in the New York State Assembly.

name: Yvette Clarke
title: U.S. Representative – NY-09
bio: Yvette Clarke has represented New York's 9th Congressional District since 2007. She serves on the House Energy and Commerce Committee and is a senior member of the Congressional Black Caucus.

name: Dan Goldman
title: U.S. Representative – NY-10
bio: Dan Goldman has represented New York's 10th Congressional District since 2023. A former federal prosecutor and lead counsel in Trump's first impeachment, his district covers lower Manhattan and parts of Brooklyn.

name: Nicole Malliotakis
title: U.S. Representative – NY-11
bio: Nicole Malliotakis represents New York's 11th Congressional District covering Staten Island. A former state assemblywoman and one of the few Republicans representing a NYC district, she has been a vocal critic of bail reform and sanctuary city policies.

name: Adriano Espaillat
title: U.S. Representative – NY-13
bio: Adriano Espaillat has represented New York's 13th Congressional District since 2017. He is the first Dominican American elected to Congress and represents upper Manhattan communities including Harlem, Washington Heights, and Inwood.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
title: U.S. Representative – NY-14
bio: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez has represented New York's 14th Congressional District since 2019. The youngest woman ever elected to Congress, she champions the Green New Deal, Medicare for All, and progressive economic policies.

name: Ritchie Torres
title: U.S. Representative – NY-15
bio: Ritchie Torres has represented New York's 15th Congressional District since 2021. He is the first openly gay Afro-Latino person elected to Congress and represents one of the poorest congressional districts in the country.

name: George Latimer
title: U.S. Representative – NY-16
bio: George Latimer represents New York's 16th Congressional District covering most of Westchester County. A former county executive and state senator, he defeated progressive incumbent Jamaal Bowman in the 2024 Democratic primary.

name: Pat Ryan
title: U.S. Representative – NY-17
bio: Pat Ryan represents New York's 17th Congressional District in the Hudson Valley. An Army veteran and former Ulster County Executive, he first won the seat in a 2022 special election and has been re-elected twice.

name: Josh Riley
title: U.S. Representative – NY-18
bio: Josh Riley represents New York's 18th Congressional District, a competitive Hudson Valley seat. He flipped the seat from Republican incumbent Marc Molinaro in 2024 and focuses on rural economic development and healthcare access.

name: Paul Tonko
title: U.S. Representative – NY-20
bio: Paul Tonko has represented New York's 20th Congressional District since 2009. He serves on the Energy and Commerce Committee and is one of Congress's most consistent climate champions, representing the Albany-Schenectady area.

name: John Mannion
title: U.S. Representative – NY-22
bio: John Mannion represents New York's 22nd Congressional District covering Syracuse and surrounding areas. A former state senator and high school teacher, he flipped the seat from Republican incumbent Brandon Williams in 2024.

name: Joe Morelle
title: U.S. Representative – NY-25
bio: Joe Morelle has represented New York's 25th Congressional District since 2018. He serves on the House Administration and Rules committees and has been an advocate for Rochester economic revitalization.

name: Tim Kennedy
title: U.S. Representative – NY-26
bio: Tim Kennedy represents New York's 26th Congressional District covering Buffalo and Erie County. A former state senator, he won the seat in a 2024 special election following Brian Higgins's retirement.

name: Andrea Stewart-Cousins
title: NY Senate Majority Leader – SD-35
bio: Andrea Stewart-Cousins has served as a State Senator since 2007 and Senate Majority Leader since 2019. She is the first woman and first Black woman to lead a legislative chamber in New York State history.

name: Rob Ortt
title: NY Senate Minority Leader
bio: Rob Ortt has represented State Senate District 62 in Western New York since 2014 and serves as Senate Minority Leader. A former mayor of North Tonawanda, he has led the Republican opposition in the chamber.

name: Liz Krueger
title: NY State Senator – SD-28 (Finance Committee Chair)
bio: Liz Krueger has represented State Senate District 28 on Manhattan's East Side since 2002. She chairs the Senate Finance Committee and is one of the most progressive members of the Senate, known for championing marijuana legalization.

name: Jamaal Bailey
title: NY State Senator – SD-36 (Codes Committee Chair)
bio: Jamaal Bailey has represented State Senate District 36 in the Bronx since 2018. He chairs the Codes Committee and has been a leading voice for criminal justice reform in the legislature.

name: Erik Bottcher
title: NY State Senator – SD-47
bio: Erik Bottcher won a February 2026 special election to represent State Senate District 47 in lower Manhattan. He previously served as a NYC Council member representing the same neighborhood and is known for LGBTQ advocacy.

name: Jeremy Zellner
title: NY State Senator – SD-61
bio: Jeremy Zellner won a February 2026 special election to represent State Senate District 61 in Erie County. He is the Erie County Democratic Committee chair and has been a key figure in Western New York Democratic politics.

name: Carl Heastie
title: NY Assembly Speaker – AD-83
bio: Carl Heastie has served as Speaker of the New York State Assembly since 2015, the first Black Speaker in New York history. He has represented Assembly District 83 in the Bronx since 2001.

name: William Barclay
title: NY Assembly Minority Leader – AD-120
bio: William Barclay has served as Assembly Minority Leader since 2020 and has represented Assembly District 120 in Oswego County since 2003. He leads the Republican opposition in the chamber.

name: Deborah Glick
title: NY State Assemblywoman – AD-66 (Higher Ed Committee Chair)
bio: Deborah Glick has represented Assembly District 66 in Greenwich Village since 1991, making her the longest-serving member of the Assembly. She was the first openly gay member elected to the New York State Legislature.

name: Keith Powers
title: NY State Assemblyman – AD-74
bio: Keith Powers won a February 2026 special election to represent Assembly District 74 on Manhattan's east side. He previously served as a NYC Council member and is known for housing, street safety, and good government work.

name: Diana Moreno
title: NY State Assemblywoman – AD-36
bio: Diana Moreno won a February 2026 special election to represent Assembly District 36 in Jackson Heights and Elmhurst, Queens. A community organizer and immigrant rights advocate, she represents one of the most diverse districts in New York.

name: Zohran Mamdani
title: Mayor of New York City
bio: Zohran Mamdani was elected Mayor of New York City in November 2025 and took office in January 2026. A Democratic Socialist and former state assemblyman, he is the first Muslim mayor of New York City.

name: Mark Levine
title: NYC Comptroller
bio: Mark Levine has served as New York City Comptroller since 2022. A former Manhattan borough president and city council member, he oversees the city's finances, audits city agencies, and manages the city pension funds.

name: Jumaane Williams
title: NYC Public Advocate
bio: Jumaane Williams has served as New York City Public Advocate since 2019. A Brooklyn native and former City Council member, he has been a vocal progressive on police accountability, housing, and tenant rights.

name: Julie Menin
title: NYC Council Speaker
bio: Julie Menin has served as NYC Council Speaker since January 2026 and represents Council District 5 in Manhattan. She previously served as a community board chair, as head of the NYC Office of Media and Entertainment, and in the Department of Consumer Affairs.

name: Brad Hoylman-Sigal
title: Manhattan Borough President
bio: Brad Hoylman-Sigal became Manhattan Borough President in January 2026, having previously served as a State Senator representing the West Side of Manhattan since 2012. He is known for LGBTQ advocacy and housing policy.

name: Sharon Lee
title: Brooklyn Borough President
bio: Antonio Reynoso serves as Brooklyn Borough President since 2022. A former City Council member, he has focused on transportation safety, green infrastructure, and economic development across Brooklyn's diverse neighborhoods.

name: Donovan Richards
title: Queens Borough President
bio: Donovan Richards has served as Queens Borough President since 2020. A former City Council member from Far Rockaway, he has focused on coastal resiliency, affordable housing, and economic opportunity in Queens.

name: Vanessa Gibson
title: Bronx Borough President
bio: Vanessa Gibson has served as Bronx Borough President since 2022. A former State Assemblywoman and City Council member, she is the first woman elected to lead the Bronx and focuses on economic development and public safety.

name: Vito Fossella
title: Staten Island Borough President
bio: Vito Fossella has served as Staten Island Borough President since 2022. A former U.S. Congressman who represented Staten Island from 1997-2009, he returned to public office after more than a decade in the private sector.

name: Mark Poloncarz
title: Erie County Executive
bio: Mark Poloncarz has served as Erie County Executive since 2012 and is one of the longest-serving county executives in New York. He has focused on fiscal stability, infrastructure investment, and economic development in the Buffalo region.

name: Bruce Blakeman
title: Nassau County Executive
bio: Bruce Blakeman has served as Nassau County Executive since 2022 and was re-elected in 2025. He is now running for Governor of New York in 2026. He has been vocal on public safety, opposing bail reform, and immigration enforcement.

name: Steve Bellone
title: Suffolk County Executive
bio: Steve Bellone has served as Suffolk County Executive since 2012. He has focused on economic development, the opioid crisis, and transportation infrastructure for the largest suburban county in New York State.

name: Daniel McCoy
title: Albany County Executive
bio: Daniel McCoy has served as Albany County Executive since 2012. He has focused on economic development, public safety, and improving county services for Albany County residents.
